input_normalization: counts -> CP10K -> log1p -> per-cell quantile binning into 51 bins (published path). Gene tokens are vocab.json ids; no <cls> token is prepended (the checkpoint was trained with no_cls=True).
output_head: ExprDecoder.fc -> dict['pred'], one scalar per gene token
output_semantics: predicted binned expression value for that gene in this cell, on the 51-bin training scale (not counts, not CP10K)
information_flow: bidirectional full attention over gene tokens; no positional encoding over genes
symmetry_evidence: measured on the demonstration cell: d ENSG00000198786 / d ENSG00000198712 = 2.840805e-02 against d ENSG00000198712 / d ENSG00000198786 = -2.048886e-02 (relative gap 1.721); the two cross entries differ by more than 10%

jacobian_check.cross_check_method: second central finite difference at step=1

substitutions: flash-attention not installed (the published checkpoint was trained with scGPT's FlashMHA layers, whose API exists only in flash-attn 1.x, which cannot build against this torch); used scGPT's own fallback torch.nn.TransformerEncoder path (use_fast_transformer=False), which changes the attention kernel and therefore the exact numerics

remapped 24 fused attention tensors from the checkpoint's FlashMHA layout (self_attn.Wqkv) onto torch's packed projection (self_attn.in_proj); both hold [query; key; value] over the same head partition, so the attention computed is the same function of the same weights. Verified numerically at load time (see attention_remap_check)
imported scgpt.model.model by file path to avoid executing scgpt/__init__ (scvi-tools / torchtext / scib); model source unmodified

notes: The published input path bins expression with np.digitize, which has zero derivative almost everywhere: the Jacobian is therefore taken through a piecewise-linear surrogate of the same quantile bin edges. binning_deviation records how far the surrogate moves the output. Checkpoint build flags inferred from the state dict: {'do_mvc': True, 'explicit_zero_prob': False, 'use_batch_labels': False, 'has_dsbn': False}. Sequence length used here is the number of resolved vocabulary genes, which exceeds the training max_seq_len of 1200; scGPT has no positional encoding over genes, so this is a context-length extrapolation rather than an invalid input.
